column1: # Decomposability classification of every feature slot the zensim attribution
# machinery can (or cannot) lay down a per-pixel density for.
# DERIVED FROM SOURCE (not from prior docs) at git 28e7bd49 / workspace ../zensim--coh:
#   zensim/src/attribution.rs           module docs L30-99 (integrand table + blind spots),
#                                       L756-838 (entry points; s[720..min(len,924)] slice at L817-821)
#                                       L6490-6550 (V2AppCoeffs — one field per contributing slot),
#   zensim/src/metric.rs                L1286-1290 (v1 372 layout: 156..228 peak / 228..300 masked / 300..372 IW)
#   E = exact          per-pixel integrand is the exact linear decomposition of the pooled feature;
#                      full-plane sum reproduces the feature (or its exact first-order removal
#                      effect) with no allocation choice and no assumed-fixed nonlinear state.
#   A = approximate    a true per-pixel integrand exists but embeds a documented approximation:
#                      nonlinear-pool first order (p-root / central moment / self-weighted soft peak),
#                      clamp-or-saturation state assumed fixed at the POOLED level, an allocation
#                      choice (blockiness 50/50), or a scale-level (not per-pixel) chain (edge width).
#   N = non-decomposable   the machinery emits exactly ZERO density for the slot regardless of the
#                      model gradient: the block is not spatialized at all (f156-371, f924-943), or
#                      the feature is reference-only / structurally zero in the regime.
#   basic    f0   + scale*39 + ch*13 + local     (13 local, 3 ch, 4 scales)
#   v1pool   f156 + <see block rows>             (216 cols: peak 156-227, masked 228-299, IW 300-371)
#   v2       f372 + scale*87 + ch*29 + local     (29 local, 3 ch, 4 scales)
#   append   f720 + scale*51 + ch*17 + local     (17 local, 3 ch, 4 scales)
#   append2  f924 + scale*5  + local             (5 local, Y-only, 4 scales)
